title: Remove assert in git_role_tmpl() as it breaks Asap documentation.
body:
As discussed with @askhl, I remove an assert statement in ``git_role_tmpl()`` in ``utils.py``, as Asap and GPAW both use this function too, and the assert fails in Asap.  The old versions of the assert are left so they can be activated when debugging.
